reading: The outer rectangle (s0) is a full-page decorative background of a precisely specified 8x6 grid of flat-colour geometric shape tiles, per the typed note, behind everything; the inner rectangle (s1) is a white, thick-bordered content block holding a heading 'Form follows fun.', an exhibition description paragraph, and a 'Book a visit' button, over a cream page with Helvetica/near-black type.
